articles.title: US urges citizens to take 'extreme caution' when using airports in Saudi Arabia
articles.summary:
US urges citizens to take 'extreme caution' when using airports in Saudi Arabia

The US State Department has urged their citizens to take "extreme caution" when travelling through airports in Saudi Arabia, amid renewed attacks.

Its official account on X said it is "aware" of additional attacks on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh and King Fahd International Airport in Dammam.

"U.S. government employees working in Saudi Arabia require special authorization to use the King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, as well as the airports in Jeddah and Dammam," the post read. 

"Please take extreme caution when using all major airports in Saudi Arabia. U.S. citizens should be aware of potential flight cancellations, airspace closures, and travel disruptions."

Saudi Arabia: The U.S. Mission is aware of additional attacks on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh and a targeted attack on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam on October 11. U.S. government employees working in Saudi Arabia require special authorization to use the King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, as well as the airports in Jeddah and Dammam. Please take extreme caution when using all major airports in Saudi Arabia. U.S. citizens should be aware of potential flight cancellations, airspace closures, and travel disruptions. We recommend checking your flight departure status directly with the airline and with the airport. Private car, train, and bus options may provide alternatives to air travel. More at: https://t.co/H8o3ylZ2wg

— TravelGov (@TravelGov) October 11, 2026

articles.title: Two Indian nationals missing after drone attack on tanker off Oman's coast
articles.summary:
Two Indian nationals missing after drone attack on tanker off Oman's coast

A drone attack on a vessel off the coast of Oman left two Indian nations missing, a senior Indian official said on Sunday.

Meanwhile, nine others were rescued, as search and rescue operations by the local coast guard begin.

"On Oct 11, tanker MT PETRO DOLPHIN, carrying 11 Indian seafarers, was subjected to a drone attack at Sohar Anchorage," Indian Shipping Minister Sarbananda Sonowal said in a post on X.

"While nine of our Indian crew members have been successfully rescued and are safe, two Indian nationals currently remain missing."

Sonowal added that India is "continuously coordinating with all relevant authorities to fully support the ongoing rescue efforts and ensure every possible action is taken to safely locate our missing personnel".

Since the war on Iran began in late February, at least 16 Indian seafarers have been killed.

The Lebanese army identified him as Ali Abdul Hassan Sweidan, and said he was directly targeted while he was inspecting his property in Yater in Bint Jbeil district.

articles.summary: Iran considers Washington’s response to its seven conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz “insufficient,” a senior Iranian official said, according to the semi-official Tasnim News Agency. Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, said the US had accepted some of Tehran’s conditions, while others remained unclear. Rogers had skipped it. “Mohammed is a Jihadist lunatic who hates our Country, the Black People of Detroit, and wants to see the U.S. fail.” The candidate’s name is Abdul El-Sayed. archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v regionu zůstává kritická kvůli odmítnutí amerického návrhu na otevření Hormuzského průlivu ze strany Íránu a přetrvávajícím vojenským operacím v Gaze a Jižním Libanonu navzdory formálním příměřím. Diplomatické vztahy mezi USA a Izraelem navíc čelí vážným tlakům a incidenty v oblasti Perského zálivu zvyšují riziko eskalace energetické krize.
archive.security_status_en: The security situation in the region remains critical due to Iran's rejection of the US proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and ongoing military operations in Gaza and southern Lebanon despite formal ceasefires. Furthermore, diplomatic relations between the US and Israel face severe strains, and maritime incidents in the Persian Gulf elevate the risk of an energy crisis escalation.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další eskalaci kolem námořní dopravy v Perském zálivu a pokračující diplomatické třenice mezi USA a Íránem ohledně Hormuzského průlivu. Operace v Gaze a jižním Libanonu budou nadále zatěžovat regionální stabilitu.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further escalation surrounding maritime traffic in the Persian Gulf and ongoing diplomatic friction between the US and Iran over the Strait of Hormuz are expected. Operations in Gaza and southern Lebanon will continue to strain regional stability.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v regionu se nadále vyostřuje, přičemž Írán odmítá americké podmínky pro otevření Hormuzského průlivu a rostou útoky na infrastrukturu včetně letiště v Rijádu a tankerů v Perském zálivu. Izraelské operace pokračují v Gaze i jižním Libanonu, kde si ostřelování vyžádalo oběti, a diplomatické napětí mezi USA a Izraelem dosahuje kritických rozměrů.
archive.security_status_en: The regional security situation continues to deteriorate as Iran rejects US conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, accompanied by rising attacks on infrastructure including Riyadh's airport and tankers in the Persian Gulf. Israeli operations persist in Gaza and southern Lebanon, where shelling has caused casualties, while diplomatic tensions between the US and Israel reach critical levels.
archive.forecast_cs: V následujících dnech lze očekávat další eskalaci napětí kolem námořní dopravy v Perském zálivu a pokračující patovou situaci v diplomatických jednáních mezi USA a Íránem ohledně Hormuzského průlivu.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further escalation of tension surrounding maritime traffic in the Persian Gulf and a continuing stalemate in diplomatic talks between the US and Iran over the Strait of Hormuz are expected.
